mcqs.keyword: Number of Chief Ministers with criminal cases
mcqs.question: According to the ADR and National Election Watch analysis of affidavits filed by 31 sitting Chief Ministers, how many had declared criminal cases?
mcqs.explanation: Fourteen of the 31 sitting Chief Ministers, constituting about 45%, had declared criminal cases. The figure 11 refers to those with serious charges, while 2 refers to attempted-murder cases.
